newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant reduces power output.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant reduces power output.

text.p: Washington Public Power Supply System's 1,158 megawatt WNP-2 nuclear power plant was operating at reduced levels as of early Thursday following problems with a recirculation pump, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The plant was working at 63 percent of capacity as of early Thursday following the "manual trip of the 1A recirculation pump," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The plant, located at Richland, Wash., had reached full power earlier this week following a reduction to deal with a problem in a new adjustable speed drive system.
